newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines mulls telephone interconnection firm.
newsitem.headline: Philippines mulls telephone interconnection firm.

text.p: The Philippines' transportation and communication department said on Wednesday it is considering setting up a company that will handle the interconnection of the country's 10 telecom companies.

Transport Secretary Amado Lagdameo has directed the creation of a committee that will study the viability of creating a company that will own and manage a tandem switch, a facility that will allow interconnection among the carriers.

Communications Undersecretary Josefina Lichauco told Reuters on Wednesday the committee will be composed of representatives from the department, the National Telecommunications Commission and the telecom firms.
New telecom firms ICC Telecoms and Smart Communications Co Inc have complained about delays by dominant carrier Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co in providing full interconnection.
Lichauco added the department has sought the help of Congress for the passage of a bill that will consider non-compliance to the interconnection mandate a criminal act.
